summary: Our objective is to learn more about high-standing rugged outcrop expressions on Mars so that in the near future when humanity is colonizing Mars we know how to build habitats on these rocks which are found in a lot of places on Mars. This in turn makes colonizing Mars easier for us to achieve.​ To reach our objective we used the resources given and found that the rover named Perseverance, passed through a geographical location which the rock formations we intend on researching. So we developed a 3d map of the location so that astronauts in the near future can easily navigate the area and research the rock formations to help in future colonization and habitat building.
details: It displays a map of a coordinated place at Mars according to the datas given from Nasa’s rover named Preseverance from 1987 Sol to 1910 Sol which can be considered as accurate and recent. This project is created by using blender and the images that are taken from Nasa’s database. Our team consider the Mars’s surface with the most accurate way possible and map it.
